citation.authors: Flynn JT, Kaelber DC, Baker-Smith CM et al

cited_by.title: Normal blood pressure by age and sex, and for children

record.population: Children and adolescents, US paediatric guideline (AAP, endorsed by the American Heart Association)
record.design: Clinical practice guideline from a review of almost 15,000 papers, 30 key action statements
record.finding: New normative blood pressure tables are based on normal-weight children. Teenagers aged 13 and over use a simplified classification that aligns with the adult American Heart Association and American College of Cardiology guideline. Screening is at preventive-care visits, and ambulatory monitoring has a larger role in diagnosis.
record.note: Abstract read; the tables themselves were not opened, so no child figure is quoted.
